slides.headline: No musician had ever received India's highest civilian honor. Then one did.
M.S. Subbulakshmi
slides.body: Born September 16, 1916 in Madurai, Subbulakshmi built a seven-decade career in Carnatic and devotional music. In 1966, she became the first Indian to perform at the United Nations General Assembly.

slides.headline: The first musician awarded the Bharat Ratna.
slides.body: In 1998, Subbulakshmi received the Bharat Ratna - India's highest civilian award - becoming the first musician in the country's history to hold it.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A single voice, recognized at the highest level.
slides.body: Her career ran across a period when India's own sense of what counted as a national achievement was still being defined. A classical singer reaching the country's highest civilian honor helped settle that question.
